signals.title: BTC spot ETF inflows hit 3-week high
signals.body: US spot ETFs absorbed 4,820 BTC in a single session, the largest single-day inflow since early April.

signals.title: ETH staking deposits surge ahead of Pectra
signals.body: Over 180,000 ETH deposited to beacon chain validators in the past 48 hours as Pectra upgrade nears.

signals.title: SOL perpetual funding rate turns deeply negative
signals.body: Solana perp funding dropped to -0.035% per 8h, signalling the highest short-side premium in six weeks.

signals.title: LINK consolidates below key $18 resistance
signals.body: Chainlink has traded in a $1.20 range for five sessions; options market implies 22% 30-day realised volatility.

signals.title: ARB bridge outflows accelerate for third day
signals.body: Net $56M left Arbitrum via canonical bridge over three consecutive days; TVL down 8% from the monthly peak.

signals.title: TAO validator stake up 18% in seven days
signals.body: Bittensor delegated stake reached 6.4M TAO following Subnet 9 launch, with active validator count rising 12%.
